title: ctenitis biserialis
intro: Ctenitis biserialis, commonly known as the biserial fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice for traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis biserialis include treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
